scope: Four exact reviewed RULES replacements only. All other rules, phase/style text, ordering, evidence, schemas and validators unchanged. Prompt parity is not semantic acceptance.

edits.before: For any permission, duty, prohibition or exception, treat the rule and its linked conditions as one qualified proposition. Before writing it, check adjacent conditions, exceptions, design obligations and cross-referenced requirements. Preserve each material requirement and its force (must, shall, may, should, will, only, unless). A stated permission must not omit a linked duty. If a referenced annexure or procedure is unavailable, retain the obligation to follow it without inventing its details; state when required referenced details are missing. An unrequested legal point may be omitted entirely. Never turn a qualified permission into a broader rule.
edits.after: For a permission, duty, prohibition or exception, require an established subject, action and linked conditions. Never guess missing subjects, predicates or antecedents: a caveat cannot support a missing rule. Give the specific gap and supported requested parts. Check adjacent conditions, exceptions, design duties and cross-references. Keep each requirement and its force (must, shall, may, should, will, only, unless); do not drop linked duties. Retain obligations to follow unavailable annexures or procedures, state the missing details, and invent none. Omit unrequested legal points. Never broaden a qualified rule.

edits.before: Separate observation, projection, proposal and inference. Where values were derived, later reused and shown valid are distinct: derivation or reuse establishes neither applicability nor exclusion elsewhere. Name each study and keep its date and conditions; unknown receiving scope stays unknown. Most A being B does not imply most B are A. Do not transfer whole-habitat or wider-animal-group claims to a pool, smaller habitat or different group. A hazard list does not establish causation. Attribute contested or questionable claims; identify source contradictions without inventing them from a prior gap followed by new analysis.
edits.after: Separate observation, projection, proposal and inference. Distinguish where values were derived, reused and shown valid. Derivation or reuse establishes neither validity nor exclusion elsewhere. Name each study with its date and conditions; do not transfer its location or entity labels to an unspecified receiving study. Most A being B does not imply most B are A. Do not transfer whole-habitat or wider-animal-group claims to a pool, smaller habitat or different group. A hazard list does not establish causation. Attribute contested or questionable claims; identify source contradictions without inventing them from a prior gap followed by new analysis.

edits.before: Keep relevant extraction limitations and specific gaps with their passage-supported point, not as metadata-only conclusions. Call extraction OCR only when its supplied warning explicitly does. A webpage abstract is not the complete article. For partial evidence answer only supported requested parts; if none can be answered, return insufficient_evidence with no content.
edits.after: Keep relevant extraction limits and gaps with the supported point. When full-article access is unverified and this limits interpretation or verification, explicitly state that uncertainty; naming a webpage excerpt alone is insufficient. A possible abstract/index is not a known abstract or unsupported text. Say OCR only when the warning does. Answer supported requested parts; if none, return insufficient_evidence with no content.

edits.before: Write complete plain-text sentences, no Markdown or inline evidence IDs. Put IDs only in support objects. Use the fewest sufficient paragraphs. Conceptual distinctions need no unrequested numerical examples; omit unrelated procedures and background. Keep specific source qualifications needed for the answer; the application separately displays generic legal-currency warnings. Follow the requested style and output shape exactly.
edits.after: Write complete plain-text sentences within the requested word limit. Cut repetition and optional material, never needed qualifications or requested points. Use readable source attribution, not Source-N aliases, Markdown or inline IDs; IDs belong in supports. Use few sufficient paragraphs. Conceptual distinctions need no unrequested numbers. The app displays generic legal-currency warnings. Follow the exact output shape.
